name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.20: allow-list tare_all, read_all_trays, probe_addresses and read_temp, with a scales and sensors panel on fridge machines. tare_all takes an optional force flag that skips the per-basket empty check; since taring a loaded basket sets a false zero and mis-charges every later sale from it, the dashboard asks whether the machine is empty rather than offering a force switch, and sends force only on an affirmative answer. read_temp returns from a deliberate removal in v6.9.1, when the fridge team reported the board exposed no temperature source; it does now. Command result payloads preserve trays, addresses, tared, refused, noReply and tempC verbatim rather than rendering only detail. The command allow-list is and always has been global, so these are available on every machine at once. Cumulative over v6.19.1.
